title: Hruday exact finite-graph first- and second-order Wilson coefficients on the two-plaquette graph (a different finite model)
selection_reason: The Z^3 remainder constant K_2 is an upper bound; a computable finite model shows what first- and second-order coefficients actually are in a truncated graph, as a labelled comparison, never a transfer.
model: FG(two-plaquette graph of Round11: two adjacent squares sharing one link, seven links, six Gauss constraints; representation cutoff j_max with certified tail; coupling tau_FG in a declared grid; I1.5 sign convention; gauge-invariant sector). model_is_finite_graph:true; transfers_to_aq:false.

parameters.observable: <W> of one square and its derivative at tau_FG=0 (must reproduce the matched first-order value under the graph's own normalization); second-order coefficient; the graph's own free reference computed in the same code path
parameters.admission: exact rational linear algebra (Fractions) with Ritz plus residual/Davis-Kahan or exact shell residual; python-flint Arb as labelled cross-check only

required: 1. Define the graph, the gauge-invariant basis, the cutoff and the certified tail (complete residual over all product channels); 2. compute exact enclosures of <W>(tau_FG) at the grid points and the derivative at zero, with the graph's own free reference; 3. compare the first-order coefficient with the matched Z^3 value 1/144 under an explicit normalization dictionary (consistency, not proof); 4. report second-order coefficients as finite-model values; 5. labels and controls: finite_graph_model_id, complete_residual_all_channels, certified_representation_tail, own_free_reference, no_transfer_to_aq, fg_coefficients_not_fitted; Arb cross-check labelled preview; freeze; skeptic replay.
claim_exclusions: any statement about the AQ model's shift or K_2 from the graph

preregistration.clock: s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar; u=s/8 and exponent 24 forbidden in packets
claim_exclusions: free reference inside enclosure => no interaction claim
whole-sequence convergence or rate in N
relabelling a static shift as dynamical

target.quantity: certified tail and enclosure widths reported

preregistration.error_terms_rule: an entry may be not_applicable only with a stated reason

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Enclosures with certified tails at every grid point; first-order coefficient consistent with the dictionary; labels present.
acceptance.limited: Tail certified only at the smaller j_max.

stop: Investigation 10 of 10; scientific production stops after this review.
